description: save: remember a fact under a topic (adds a line; replace rewrites the note)
whenever the user states a preference, asks you to remember something,
or you learn something lasting about a project.
read: a topic's note (the index of topics is already in your instructions).

params.name: topic
params.description: Short topic name, e.g. preferences or core_dump; omit it with read for the index

params.name: text
params.description: save: the fact to remember, one short sentence (or the whole note with replace)

params.name: summary
params.description: save: a one-line summary of the topic for the index; omit it to keep the current one

params.name: replace
params.description: save: rewrite the whole note with text instead of adding a line
